Type.description: The deployment step type name, which is the step's CLR type name, for example ContentDeploymentStep. The well known payload of 'Step' depends on this value.

Step.description: The deployment step payload. The well known members depend on the value of 'Type'. Marker steps that export everything of a kind use an empty object.

items.description: A deployment step that belongs to the plan.

Step.description: AI Personas step. Exports all or the selected saved AI personas. Persona files ship with the code and are not exported. Payload for the 'AIPersonaDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all saved AI personas and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

PersonaIds.description: The item ids of the saved AI personas to export when IncludeAll is false.

Step.description: Child tenant access step. Exports who in the parent tenant may sign in to child tenants, and with which roles there. Payload for the 'AccessGrantsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Accounts step. Exports every account with its members, locations and other parts, and optionally the records the accounts hold. Payload for the 'AccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeRecords.description: Whether the records the accounts hold, such as their contacts and opportunities, are exported too.

Step.description: All admin templates step. Exports every admin template. Payload for the 'AllAdminTemplatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsFiles.description: When true, exports each admin template as a separate file rather than embedding them in the recipe.

Step.description: All content step. Exports every content item on the tenant. Payload for the 'AllContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: All features step. Exports the list of enabled features. Payload for the 'AllFeaturesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IgnoreDisabledFeatures.description: When true, the exported recipe only enables features and does not disable any that are currently off.

Step.description: All Rate Limit Policies step. Exports every rate-limit policy as a 'CreateOrUpdateRateLimitPolicies' recipe step. Payload for the 'AllRateLimitPoliciesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
All templates step. Exports every front end template. Payload for the 'AllTemplatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ExportAsFiles.description: When true, exports each template as a separate file rather than embedding them in the recipe.

Step.description: Asset types and assets step. Exports every asset type, and every asset with its owner, place and parent. Payload for the 'AssetsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAssets.description: When true, exports the assets too.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to export.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Azure AI Search index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Azure AI Search indexes. Payload for the 'AzureAISearchIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Azure AI Search indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Azure AI Search indexes to reset.

Step.description: Booking dates step. Exports the booking products' upcoming open dates with their capacity and price. Payload for the 'BookingDatesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Calendars step. Exports every calendar, optionally with its events and everyone's categories. Payload for the 'CalendarsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeEvents.description: When true, exports the events of each calendar too, up to 10,000 per calendar.

IncludeCategories.description: When true (the default), exports everyone's categories too, so the events keep their colors.

Step.description: Content definitions step. Exports the selected content type and content part definitions. Payload for the 'ContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all content type and content part definitions and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to export.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to export.

Step.description: Content step. Exports the content items of the selected content types. Payload for the 'ContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content types whose items are exported.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: Content item step. Exports a single content item selected by its identifier. Payload for the 'ContentItemDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentItemId.description: The identifier of the content item to export.

Step.description: Coupons step. Exports every coupon and automatic discount, without how often it was used. Payload for the 'CouponsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Custom file step. Adds an arbitrary text file, with the supplied content, to the deployment package. Payload for the 'CustomFileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

FileName.description: The name of the file written to the deployment package.

FileContent.description: The text content of the file.

Step.description: Custom settings step. Exports the site settings for the selected custom settings types. Payload for the 'CustomSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all custom settings types and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

SettingsTypeNames.description: The technical names of the custom settings content types to export.

Step.description: Custom user settings step. Exports the custom user settings for the selected settings types. Payload for the 'CustomUserSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all custom user settings types and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

SettingsTypeNames.description: The technical names of the custom user settings content types to export.

Step.description: Customers step. Exports the guest and business customers with their addresses. Customers with a user account, and erased or merged customers, are left out. Payload for the 'CustomersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Data Pipelines step. Exports the data pipelines with their published definition, or their draft when they were never published. The secrets of the steps are not exported. Payload for the 'DataPipelinesDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all data pipelines, including the ones created after the step was added to the plan, and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

PipelineIds.description: The identifiers of the data pipelines to export when 'IncludeAll' is false.

Step.description: Delete content definitions step. Deletes the selected content type and content part definitions on the target. Payload for the 'DeleteContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to delete.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to delete.

Step.description: Deployment plans step. Exports the selected deployment plans. Payload for the 'DeploymentPlanDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all deployment plans and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

DeploymentPlanNames.description: The names of the deployment plans to export.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to export.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Elasticsearch index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Elasticsearch indexes. Payload for the 'ElasticsearchIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Elasticsearch indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Indices.description: The names of the Elasticsearch indexes to reset.

Step.description: Exemption certificates step. Exports customers' tax exemption certificates with their types, jurisdictions and dates. Payload for the 'ExemptionCertificateDeploymentStep' deployment step.
File sources step. Exports every file source with its connector settings. Passwords, keys and other secrets are never exported. Payload for the 'FileSourcesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Service territories step. Exports every service territory, with its shape or postal codes, parent and time zone. Payload for the 'GeoDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Index profile settings step. Exports the settings of the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'IndexProfileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to export.

Step.description: JSON recipe step. Adds the supplied raw JSON recipe steps to the deployment package. Payload for the 'JsonRecipeDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Json.description: The raw JSON, containing one or more recipe steps, added to the deployment package.

Step.description: Local DNC lists step. Exports every imported local do-not-call list with its phone numbers. Phone numbers are personal data. Payload for the 'LocalDncListsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Loyalty points step. Exports every customer's loyalty points, with their activity. Payload for the 'LoyaltyAccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Lucene index settings step. Exports the settings of the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to export.

Step.description: Lucene index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexRebuildDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to rebuild.

Step.description: Lucene index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected Lucene indexes. Payload for the 'LuceneIndexResetDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all Lucene indexes and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the Lucene indexes to reset.

Step.description: Marketing segments and campaigns step. Exports every marketing segment and campaign. Campaigns are exported without their status and counts, and import as drafts. Payload for the 'MarketingDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Markets step. Exports every market with its countries, currency, exchange rate and rounding. Payload for the 'MarketsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Media step. Exports the selected media files and directories. Payload for the 'MediaDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all media files and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

FilePaths.description: The paths of the individual media files to export.

DirectoryPaths.description: The paths of the media directories to export, including their contents.

Step.description: Memberships step. Exports every membership with its member by user name, its product, roles and dates. Payload for the 'MembershipsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Tax registrations step. Exports the store's own tax registrations with their jurisdictions, numbers and thresholds. Payload for the 'MerchantTaxRegistrationDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Messaging broadcasts step. Exports every broadcast with its message and recipients, without its status or counts. Broadcasts import as drafts, so nothing is sent. Payload for the 'MessagingBroadcastsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Price Lists step. Exports every price list with its prices. Payload for the 'PriceListsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Query based content step. Exports the content items returned by a named query. Payload for the 'QueryBasedContentDeploymentStep' deployment step.

QueryName.description: The name of the query whose returned content items are exported.

QueryParameters.description: A JSON object, serialized as a string, holding the parameter values passed to the query.

ExportAsSetupRecipe.description: When true, exports the content in a form suitable for a setup recipe, resetting owner and identifier information.

Step.description: Index rebuild step. Instructs the target to rebuild the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'RebuildIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to rebuild.

Step.description: Recipe metadata step. Writes the recipe metadata, such as name, author and version, into the exported recipe file. Payload for the 'RecipeFileDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Description.description: A description explaining what the recipe does.

WebSite.description: A website URL associated with the recipe.

IsSetupRecipe.description: Whether the recipe can be used to set up a new tenant.

Categories.description: A comma separated list of categories the recipe belongs to.

Tags.description: A comma separated list of tags describing the recipe.

Step.description: Referral codes step. Exports every customer's referral code, with the referrals it earned. Payload for the 'ReferralProfilesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Registers step. Exports every point-of-sale register with its store location, address, currency and roles. Payload for the 'RegistersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Replace content definitions step. Exports the selected content type and content part definitions so they replace, rather than merge with, the definitions on the target. Payload for the 'ReplaceContentDefinitionDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all content type and content part definitions and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ContentTypes.description: The technical names of the content type definitions to export.

ContentParts.description: The technical names of the content part definitions to export.

Step.description: Designed Reports and Views step. Exports designed reports, the views they read and their report groups. Share links are never exported. Payload for the 'ReportDesignsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all reports, views and report groups and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

ReportIds.description: The itemIds of the reports to export when IncludeAll is false. Their groups and every view they read are exported too.

ViewIds.description: The itemIds of extra views to export when IncludeAll is false. The views they read are exported too.

Step.description: Index reset step. Instructs the target to reset the selected index profiles. Payload for the 'ResetIndexDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all index profiles and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

IndexNames.description: The names of the index profiles to reset.

Step.description: Scheduling step. Exports appointment types and scheduling resources, and optionally the appointments and the waitlist. Payload for the 'SchedulingDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAppointments.description: When true, exports every appointment too, with its customer's details but without its manage link.

IncludeWaitlist.description: When true, exports the waitlist too.

Step.description: Secrets step. Exports the secrets. Without an encryption key, only their metadata is exported, and the importing site reads the values from its configuration. Payload for the 'SecretsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

EncryptionKeyName.description: The name of the RsaKeySecret or X509Secret that holds the public key of the destination. When set, the secret values are exported encrypted with it; otherwise only the metadata is exported.

Step.description: Shipping zones step. Exports every shipping zone with its countries, regions and shipping methods. Payload for the 'ShippingZonesDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Site settings step. Exports the selected sections of the site settings. Payload for the 'SiteSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Settings.description: The names of the site settings sections to export, for example BaseUrl or TimeZoneId.

Step.description: Skills and certifications step. Exports every skill and certification, and optionally the skills and certificates people hold. Payload for the 'SkillsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAssignments.description: When true, exports the skills people hold too, with the skill name so they import on another site.

IncludeCertificationRecords.description: When true, exports the certificates people hold too.

Step.description: Stock locations step. Exports the store's own stock locations, with their ids, so stock and registers keep pointing at them. Payload for the 'StockLocationsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Store credit step. Exports every customer's store credit, with its balance and activity. Payload for the 'StoreCreditAccountsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Teams step. Exports every team, with its parent by name. Payload for the 'TeamsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Time stages, categories and entries step. Exports the time categories and stages, and optionally the entries of the last days. Payload for the 'TimeTrackerDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeEntries.description: When true, exports the time entries too.

Days.description: How many days back entries are exported.

Step.description: Data translations step. Exports the data localization translations for the selected cultures and categories. Payload for the 'TranslationsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAll.description: When true, exports all cultures and categories and the accompanying selection array is ignored. When false, only the named entries are exported.

Cultures.description: The culture codes whose translations are exported, for example fr-FR.

Step.description: Vendors step. Exports every marketplace vendor with its users by name and its commission. Payout accounts are not exported. Payload for the 'VendorsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Web crawlers step. Exports every web crawler with its crawl settings. Secrets are never exported. Payload for the 'WebCrawlersDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Webhook subscriptions step. Exports every webhook subscription without its signing secret. Payload for the 'WebhookSubscriptionsDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Work order settings step. Exports work order types, checklists, service levels and sub-statuses, and service agreements when asked. Payload for the 'WorkOrdersDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeAgreements.description: When true, exports the agreements too.

Step.description: Adherence rule sets step. Exports every adherence rule set, with the teams it applies to and its rules. Payload for the 'WorkforceAdherenceDeploymentStep' deployment step.
Workforce teams and workers step. Exports the activity codes and the team hierarchy, and optionally the workers. Payload for the 'WorkforceDeploymentStep' deployment step.

IncludeWorkers.description: When true, exports every worker too, with their teams by name. Sensitive details such as the date of birth are left out.

Step.description: Forecasting setup step. Exports every planning group, forecast event and capacity plan. Payload for the 'WorkforceForecastingDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Workforce settings step. Exports shift templates, rotations, coverage requirements, time-off settings, time clock settings (with kiosks, never their tokens, and the payroll CSV columns) and labor rule sets, for the features that are on. Payload for the 'WorkforceSettingsDeploymentStep' deployment step.

Steps.description: Deployment steps that belong to the plan.

Plans.description: Deployment plans to create or update.
